question: In a certain code, PLANE is written as QMBOF. How is TRAIN written in that code?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter is shifted 1 position forward in the English alphabet.

Given,

P L A N E ⇒ Q M B O F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3c2f4d0fa40061092323300cb090a57af6b388063326702efd18521c1820146.png] 

Now, T R A I N:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aac708b779f38a206f8621d8c01e8099916dac82d84f665cb96137c462a388ab.png] 

So, T R A I N ⇒ U S B J O

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
